summary: Keep reviewer preparation optional, source-grounded and triggered by research context; reuse study notes.
revisit: At a relevant next review, appraise unfamiliar measurements, cross-domain disagreement, unusual hypotheses or contrary evidence. Preserve prior progress and scope; no blanket retrospective reread.
acceptance: Identify object, measurement, task and evidence scope; reuse notes, reread sources at genuine uncertainties and revise prior understanding against evidence while retaining the first-draft/revisor/revision path.
adoption: User-confirmed optional policy, not an empirical superiority rule.

evidence_scope.scope: First-party optional design choice. A bounded internal review comparison did not establish general superiority or measure two-arm author revision benefit; detailed working evidence is retained locally.
